meta.author: Śrīla Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur
meta.first_line: bhāi re! eka-dina śāntipure prabhu advaitera ghare

translation: *The following three compositions are also recited occasionally:*
O brother! One day in Śāntipur at the house of Advaita Prabhu, the two Lords sat down to eat. Tasting the śāk, the Lord said, “O devotees, Kṛṣṇa has tasted this śāk.
“By tasting such śāk, divine love for Kṛṣṇa arises in the heart. With such love, taste this śāk. Everyone should give up mundane conceptions, take this prasād, and chant, ‘Hari! Hari!’”
